issues.description: Reject test fixtures have `fix.text` values that contradict the `fixed` output strings
issues.detail: Several new reject cases set `fix.text: '0deg'` while the corresponding `fixed` string shows insertions like `10deg` or `120deg`. Either the harness silently ignores `fix` when `fixed` is present (dead noise) or it validates and the fixtures are wrong. Clean these up before landing.

issues.description: The `+2` offset for relative-color syntax is an unstated invariant that complects parse-tree shape with color semantics
issues.detail: `findHue` shifts channel indices by 2 when `args[0]` is `from`, assuming exactly one origin-color node follows. This positional convention isn't documented, isn't asserted, and silently couples to parser-tree shape. A short comment naming the invariant, named index constants, or a small `getChannels(node)` helper would make the meaning explicit.

The `0 +` adds no information and breaks symmetry awkwardly with `args[2 + offset]`. Either write `args[offset]` directly or introduce named constants like `HUE_FIRST_INDEX` / `HUE_THIRD_INDEX`. Trivial readability fix the next maintainer will appreciate.

issues.description: `args[0]?.value` checks string without asserting node type is `word`
issues.detail: After filtering to word|function nodes, only word nodes carry a meaningful `from` keyword, but a function named `from` would also match `.value === 'from'`. Add an explicit `args[0]?.type === 'word'` check so the fact being tested is unambiguous, and the optional-chain stops masking the empty-args invariant.

issues.description: Test coverage misses `none`, `calc()` channels, and nested relative-color reject cases
issues.detail: CSS Color 5 allows `none` and `calc(...)` for any channel including hue. Tests cover identifiers and numbers but not `oklch(from red l c none)` or `oklch(from red l c calc(h + 10))`. Also no reject test for a nested relative color whose inner function contains a violating hue. These are exactly where false positives/regressions hide.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch is small, focused, and correctly handles the relative-color hue-channel offset. Main blocker before landing: reject-test fixtures where `fix.text` contradicts the `fixed` output strings need cleanup. Secondary concern: the `+2` offset encodes parse-tree shape as arithmetic without documenting the invariant — a comment, named constants, or a small `getChannels` helper would make it explicit. Minor cleanups (`0 + offset`, type-check on `args[0]`, broader coverage for `none`/`calc()` and nested relative colors) round out the list. Verdict: needs-work but close to landing.
